📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Priya opens the pantry wide: 8× Jerusalem Artichoke, 1× Foraged food, 2× Foraged food. Gus, Zoltan eat until the fire burns low. Somebody tells the story again, the one everybody already knows. For one evening, hunger feels like a rumor. (−1,540 kcal from the pantry) The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)

📺 Windfall. A storm dropped a fortune — fruit, game, a stranded fish haul — and every bit of it is rotting on camera. Beat the rot: eat, dry, haul. The clock is spoilage.

People have been hurt in this one. Not always.

The lights come up. You can hear the crowd — millions of them, somewhere past the sky.

The storm's leavings, spread across the meadow: berry bushes stripped and scattered, a downed deer, a stranded fish haul flopping in a cut-off pool, fruit everywhere.

All of it is rotting. Right now. On camera. The System, cheerful: "BEAT THE ROT. EAT, DRY, HAUL. THE CLOCK IS SPOILAGE."
